selection: Everycar active/path-count transition: force rowsK,K+1,K+2; everycar force maximum; rowsat400/500/600s; first computedrow. Deduplicate by forceRow/car; approximately100–300 calls, no downsampling of the full route reference.
phase_contract: expected force at rowN uses CarTunnelData, train length/mass and local absolute speed from rowN−1; current car mass/dimensions are static SF hardware. Outside-tunnel rows retain expected0 and verify captured phase; geometry helper is invoked only for active previous context.
hardware_contract: car_cross_section_m2 is computed by Single width*height from static dimensions. No observed TrainCrossSectionAreaM2 field enters the model. Route Single/Double area/perimeter are source defaults from authoredTRK SpeedLimit223.52m/s and absent author overrides (70/32 and100/37.5).
tunnel_length_contract: Single(Ahead+Behind) from previous CarTunnelData, not fullgroup physical length; fields carry explicit nullable validity bits.
scope: Isolated native subsystem with prescribed geometry/speed/mass inputs only. Full closed-loop route must derive geometry and motion itself; no sampled tunnel forces/positions/states may drive acceptance.
acceptance: No original threshold or fixture is regenerated to make Rust pass; failed attempts retained.
